experimental_method: Steady-state flow microcalorimeter: gas pumped at a steady rate into flowing water; power from the dissolution measured by thermopile; 25 C, gas partial pressure about 86-88 kPa; converted to standard state with second virial coefficients.
uncertainties_stated: Calorimetric dH0: twice the standard error of the mean; precision for oxygen 0.2 percent, accuracy better than 0.5 percent at 25 C; precision generally better than 1 percent.

Table I values printed positive while standard values (Table II) are negative: sign convention for Table I is inferred (scale -1 in mapping). not_extracted_tables: Table III (standard partial molar thermodynamic functions dG0, dH0, dS0, S_aq at 25 C): derived/compiled quantities (dG0 and entropies from literature solubilities, dH0 repeated from Table II)
